name: Radnor
description: Radnor was a small, sea-covered planet with a small main landmass, and prevailing winds. It was located in the same system as Avon. Radnor had two capitals: the Twin Cities of Aubendo and Tacto. Each of the cities had their own governing ministers. Radnor was known for its research and development of high-tech weapons systems.
